plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official Ashland University 'B.A. in Computer Science (Minor Required) Four Year Curriculum Guide (Odd Years)' (Department of Mathematics and Computer Science; published December 2022; still the current guide posted on ashland.edu as of 2026-10-01). The same PDF also contains an 'Even Years' variant (upper-division CS courses swap fall/spring years); this plan follows the Odd Years rotation as published first. 15+16+15+15+15+15+15+14 = 120 credits ('120 hours' stated). Placeholder slots (CORE, CS elective, MINOR, GENERAL) are choice:true with the guide's own slot labels as codes. The Year 3 Fall software-engineering slot is an either/or: SDD 241 Introduction to Software Engineering (fall only) OR MIS 372 Systems Analysis and Design (fall only). Prereqs are not stated on the 4-year guide and are therefore omitted. tccns mirrors the local course code (non-Texas school). transfer_confidence is 'core_only'.
